# enterpriseai.tools

> An open-source landscape tracker for enterprise AI tooling (101 tools across 9 categories). Each record links to an official source; the dataset is governed by `data/SCHEMA.md` and updated weekly.

Edited through a regulated-enterprise delivery lens: governance posture, deployment surface, ownership, sourcing quality, and operational fit are weighted above launch marketing. Analytics are consent-gated: nothing third-party loads unless a visitor opts in, and there is no sign-up, no email capture, and no advertising.

## Per-tool pages
Every tracked tool is indexed at https://www.enterpriseai.tools/tools/ and has its own page at `/tools/<id>` carrying the full source-backed governance posture (data residency, deployment model, audit logging, SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / ISO 42001, EU AI Act role, license risk), with a primary source URL on every asserted claim.

## Hub pages
- [Home](https://www.enterpriseai.tools/): stack map of the 9 tracked categories in three layers (build & orchestrate, control plane, use) on top of the foundation platforms.
- [AI Platforms & Model Hubs](https://www.enterpriseai.tools/platforms/): Microsoft Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (formerly Google Vertex AI).
- Build & orchestrate ([https://www.enterpriseai.tools/build/](https://www.enterpriseai.tools/build/)):
  - [AI Agent Frameworks](https://www.enterpriseai.tools/agents/): cloud agent platforms + open-source frameworks.
  - [AI Orchestration](https://www.enterpriseai.tools/orchestration/): workflow engines and automation.
- Control plane: govern, secure, observe ([https://www.enterpriseai.tools/control-plane/](https://www.enterpriseai.tools/control-plane/)):
  - [Agent Registry & Management](https://www.enterpriseai.tools/control-planes/): agent inventory, ownership, lifecycle, fleet policy.
  - [Agent Identity & Access](https://www.enterpriseai.tools/agent-identity/): identities and scoped access for AI agents.
  - [AI Guardrails & Agent Security](https://www.enterpriseai.tools/governance/): guardrails, content safety, agent security posture.
  - [AI Observability & Evaluation](https://www.enterpriseai.tools/observability/): tracing, evals, and cost monitoring.
  - [AI & MCP Gateways](https://www.enterpriseai.tools/gateways/): LLM routing, cost control, and MCP tool governance.
- Use ([https://www.enterpriseai.tools/use/](https://www.enterpriseai.tools/use/)):
  - [AI Assistants](https://www.enterpriseai.tools/assistants/): coding, productivity, build-your-own.
  - [Always-on AI Agents](https://www.enterpriseai.tools/always-on-agents/): persistent personal and team agents, with their security record.
- [Start with your question](https://www.enterpriseai.tools/start/): step-by-step paths across the stack (assistants rollout, first agent in production, governing existing agents, always-on agents).
- Vendor stacks ([https://www.enterpriseai.tools/stacks/](https://www.enterpriseai.tools/stacks/)): what Microsoft ([https://www.enterpriseai.tools/stacks/microsoft/](https://www.enterpriseai.tools/stacks/microsoft/)), AWS ([https://www.enterpriseai.tools/stacks/aws/](https://www.enterpriseai.tools/stacks/aws/)) and Google ([https://www.enterpriseai.tools/stacks/google/](https://www.enterpriseai.tools/stacks/google/)) offer at each layer.
- [Weekly updates](https://www.enterpriseai.tools/updates/): high-impact market intelligence + release log.
- [EU AI Act tracker](https://www.enterpriseai.tools/eu-ai-act/): obligations by role, application timeline, and a subscribable deadline calendar (https://www.enterpriseai.tools/eu-ai-act-deadlines.ics).
- [Help me evaluate](https://www.enterpriseai.tools/evaluate/): guided client-side flow that ranks tools by governance fit.
- [About](https://www.enterpriseai.tools/about/): project scope, sourcing standards, and contribution rules.
- [Methodology](https://www.enterpriseai.tools/methodology/): how every claim is sourced and verified.
- [Inclusion criteria](https://www.enterpriseai.tools/inclusion-criteria/): the written rules for what gets listed.
- [Impartiality](https://www.enterpriseai.tools/impartiality/): the permanent no-paid-placement policy.
- [Privacy](https://www.enterpriseai.tools/privacy/): what is and is not collected, and the consent-gated analytics policy.

## Data
- Full content for LLMs (single fetch): [llms-full.txt](https://www.enterpriseai.tools/llms-full.txt)
- Open data API index (versioned JSON): https://www.enterpriseai.tools/api/v1/index.json
- Tools dataset (JSON): https://www.enterpriseai.tools/api/v1/tools.json (per record: https://www.enterpriseai.tools/api/v1/tools/<id>.json)
- Platforms dataset (JSON): https://www.enterpriseai.tools/api/v1/platforms.json
- Updates dataset (JSON): https://www.enterpriseai.tools/api/v1/updates.json
- Consumption guide: https://www.enterpriseai.tools/data/
- Every per-tool page: https://www.enterpriseai.tools/sitemap.xml
- Updates feed (Atom): https://www.enterpriseai.tools/updates.xml (per category: https://www.enterpriseai.tools/updates-<category>.xml)
- License-change feed (Atom): https://www.enterpriseai.tools/updates-licenses.xml — relicensing events only
- EU AI Act deadline calendar (ICS): https://www.enterpriseai.tools/eu-ai-act-deadlines.ics
- Source: https://github.com/tiberiuarva/enterpriseaitools

## Editorial standards
- Source-backed or not published. Every record carries a primary-source URL.
- License labels match upstream `LICENSE` files exactly; corrections go through a dedicated issue rather than silent edits.
- Canonical product names are tracked; prior names are preserved in `formerNames` / `aliases`.

## Curator
Tiberiu Arva — enterprise financial-services delivery lens.
